Pisana — Rome, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Pisana (La Pisana / Bravetta area, along the busy Via della Pisana toward the GRA) is a residential and semi-suburban zone. Press research found a December 2025 arrest of two men found with burglary tools near Via della Pisana, and a separate case of four arrests for heroin and cocaine dealing spanning the Trullo and La Pisana areas. There have also been several serious traffic accidents on this heavily trafficked road, though those are a road-safety rather than crime issue. Given the documented but limited drug-dealing and burglary activity, days remain green while nights get a cautious yellow.
